quotes.text: The schema declares separate Manifest V2 and V3 signatures for operations such as folders.create and messages.move. Manifest V3 takes folderId rather than a MailFolder or MailAccount object; Manifest V2 retains deprecated object forms. This is an API compatibility boundary, so review a new folder-taking method in both schema and implementation and do not document old object input as valid for Manifest V3.
